meta.title: SquishyFile — Free Video Compressor, No Watermark or Limit
meta.description: Free online video compressor for MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI and WebM — no uploads, no file-size limit, no watermark, no sign up required.

hero.title: Squish your videos, keep the quality
hero.subtitle: 100% free video compression with no file-size limit and no watermark. Runs entirely in your browser, no uploads needed — supports MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI and WebM, and output is always a clean H.264 MP4.

meta.title: Compress Video to 10MB, 25MB or Any Size — SquishyFile
meta.description: Shrink your video to an exact size — 10MB, 25MB or any target — for email, Discord, WhatsApp and Instagram limits. 100% free, no watermark, no sign up.

hero.title: Compress your video to an exact file size
hero.subtitle: Type in a target size in MB and SquishyFile does the math — perfect for email, Discord uploads, or any platform with a strict size limit. Works with MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI and WebM, exports as MP4.

meta.title: Compress Video on iPhone in Safari — No App Needed
meta.description: Compress video on your iPhone right in Safari — no app to install. Pick a video from Photos and shrink it down for free; nothing ever leaves your phone.

hero.title: Compress video on iPhone, right in Safari
hero.subtitle: No app to install — just open this page in Safari, pick a video from your Photos library, and squish it down to size. Everything runs on your iPhone, right in the browser, nothing is uploaded.
